GitHub #403's cube at 5 mm (mitcad#1954; opened with --open, never committed; tools/cli/fillet-exact-reported-test.cmake): a cube of 10 (Extrude1 F2, Body1), Fillet1 (F3) of radius 5 on all its edges (ten edges and a face's four), the corners' balls at both ends of each edge meeting in its middle. Built before as the cube rounded 0.1 % smaller with its warning and slivers of every face; now exactly as the cube's core (its middle point) swept by the ball: the ball of 5, one face, no warning or information.
